# TASK-111 — Project and page UX consolidation

- **Status:** In progress — implemented, verification incomplete
- **Area:** Product follow-up (requested 2026-09-28)

## Intent

Project and page UX consolidation: concise summaries, progressive details, less repeated explanatory copy, responsive image sizing, and consistent project-level detail views.

## What it delivers

Overview now has unframed sections, a smaller progress indicator and expandable score/workflow/history details. Publish & handoff groups exports by audience (coding agents, documents, data); Readiness leads with the next step, groups blockers by kind with Fix links and folds warnings away; the specification outline collapses. Project detail work (TASK-112) remains.
